scope: Original procedural aircraft visuals and narrow pawn presentation hooks only

components.AircraftVisualsRoot: USceneComponent attached to unchanged FlightCollision sphere
components.AircraftAirframe: UProceduralMeshComponent attached to AircraftVisualsRoot; five material sections
components.AircraftPropeller: UProceduralMeshComponent attached to AircraftVisualsRoot at local X=390 cm; one section
components.AircraftParts: BlueprintReadOnly array now typed UProceduralMeshComponent; contains only AircraftAirframe and AircraftPropeller
components.visibility: Existing CalcCamera 650 cm proximity threshold and SetOwnerNoSee behavior retained for both replacement renderers

dependencies: Existing public ProceduralMeshComponent module; no module/plugin changes
Existing /Game/Materials/M_FlightSurface.M_FlightSurface; native Tint and Roughness parameter checks retained
No new assets, textures, third-party aircraft data, branding, or downloads

materials.cache: Five pawn-owned transient MIDs, shared between airframe sections and propeller
materials.failureBehavior: Log error plus existing HUD FlightStatus; geometry remains invisible rather than showing white fallback. Empty status after reset is restored to material error while visuals are unavailable.

geometry.design: Original tapered elliptical fuselage, closed cambered teardrop wing sections with swept rounded taper and thickness, shaped tailplane/fin, framed dark canopy, contrasting wingtips, brass racing stripe and cowling panels, spinner and three modeled propeller blades
geometry.generation: BuildGeometry is pure/deterministic with no UObject/world access. CPU geometry cached once; mesh sections created once per pawn in BeginPlay, never on the CDO or per frame.
geometry.collision: All visual components NoCollision, ignore all channels, no overlaps/navigation/physics; every CreateMeshSection passes bCreateCollision=false.
geometry.propeller: Presentation-only roll transform updated at no more than 30 Hz from existing pawn Tick; no component ticks, no coupling to thrust, simulation or weapon timing; updates skipped while owner-hidden
geometry.winding: Unreal clockwise (C-A)x(B-A), smooth outward normals, UV-aligned tangents with mirrored-wing handedness

pawnHooks: Constructor replaces eight primitive components with one scene root and two procedural renderers
InitializeAircraftMaterials validates/caches finishes and creates mesh sections once
Tick calls UpdateAircraftVisuals after the existing unchanged simulation/state update
UpdateReadableState preserves explicit material-failure status when necessary
CalcCamera iterates the procedural AircraftParts instead of static meshes
preserved: 470 cm collision sphere and all root collision settings
650 cm weapon muzzle remains ahead of maximum visual X=445 cm; no Weapons edits
Flight simulation, 30-65 m/s range, input bindings and every control method unchanged
Chase camera settings and camera proximity hiding unchanged
